notes: PrefLib file 00021-00000012.toi (dataset 00021, 'sf'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 238 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

label_sources.official_winners: Wikipedia, "November 2011 San Francisco general election" and "2011 San Francisco mayoral election" (final-round tables).
label_sources.max_ranks: Alameda County and San Francisco ranked-choice ballots allowed 3 rankings (every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).
